name: Bosutinib Monohydrate

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Gastrointestinal Toxicity: Monitor and manage as necessary. Withhold, dose reduce, or discontinue BOSULIF. ( 2.3 , 5.1 ) • Myelosuppression: Monitor blood counts and manage as necessary. Withhold, dose reduce, or discontinue BOSULIF. ( 2.4 , 5.2 ) • Hepatic Toxicity: Monitor liver enzymes…

summary: Official warnings note that patients need monitoring for digestive system harm, liver damage indicated by liver enzymes, and myelosuppression, which is a condition that lowers blood cell counts [3]. Depending on the severity of these problems, doctors may need to manage symptoms, lower the medication amount, or stop the drug entirely [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model rather than tests on people assigned a high risk score to the liver and a medium risk score to the heart [M].
